principles: Keep the workflow reusable across projects.
Keep project-specific startup, observation, and assertions inside adapters and acceptance cases.
Use real acceptance tests against the running product whenever possible.
Do not bypass the product architecture to make acceptance pass.

roles.human: Idea owner, result inspector, final decision maker.
roles.chatgpt: Requirement clarifier, architect, generalization reviewer, acceptance analyst, context manager.
roles.codex: Code reader, implementer, script runner, fixer.
roles.acceptanceSystem: Runs real tests and writes standardized evidence reports.
